title: Cosmo picks the tile size from the result size
description: Fabio 2026-10-23: the bigger the picture, the bigger the tile, or a 16K result at 256 px tiles is 4,004 tiles. Cosmo's guide (docs/agent/upscaling.md, Running tiles) gets a result-size -> tileSize rule aiming at about 20 tiles; the user's own tile size still wins.
